_comment: Regional language variants a dialect technique translates the prompt into, on the machine-translation model (TranslateGemma), one row per technique (the dialect generator of combination_spec.json makes to_dialect_{slug}). It reuses the translation machinery (jailbreak/obfuscation/translation.py) under the translation switch. name: the variant as the prompt and info write it. slug: the end of the technique name. code: the region/script code TranslateGemma is sent (its chat template maps a region code to the base language's name and puts the code in the instruction). base: the base translation language of languages.json whose measured MEDIAN_RATIO the length band uses, since no dialect ratio is measured yet (a pod measurement is pending; see .claude/completion_blockers.md). script: the ISO 15924 code of the variant's script. labels: the GlotLID labels the output may carry (GlotLID tells the base language, not the region, so these are the base language's labels plus any dialect label GlotLID has). trad_share: for zh-Hant, the minimum share of Han characters that must be Traditional (not in the Simplified set) for the output to count as Traditional Chinese; omitted for the others. no_eszett: for de-CH, true: Swiss Standard German writes ss (SS) for the sharp s, so a piece holding the letter (lower or upper case) is rejected, reason eszett, and translated again; omitted for the others. Read from the package only.
